svg.text: AI FUEL EFFICIENCY PROGRAM | MY ROLE
My role sat between airline leadership, the business case and the technical implementation required to make the AI use case real

g.text: WHAT I DROVE ACROSS THE ENGAGEMENT
STRATEGY / VALUE
• Structured AI use-case identification and prioritization
• Developed the business / value case for fuel-efficiency opportunities
• Framed investment and implementation choices for leadership
SOLUTION / REQUIREMENTS
• Translated operating opportunities into data / tech / analytics requirements
• Shaped AI-enabled decision support and implementation requirements
• Defined a scalable technology and implementation roadmap
OPERATING MODEL / IMPLEMENTATION
• Shaped governance, operating processes and adoption mechanisms
• Connected technical delivery to operational decision points
• Supported cross-functional implementation end to end
SPECIALIST INPUTS THE PROGRAM NEEDED
Data engineering
Source integration, quality, lineage, feature availability
Data science / analytics
Model development, validation, error analysis, explainability
Technology / architecture
Integration pattern, environment, security, deployment
Operations
Feasibility, decision timing, workflow and actionability
Finance / benefits
Baseline, attribution, unit economics, realized value
Change / business owners
Adoption, ownership, training, process integration
IMPORTANT DISTINCTION
I did not position myself as the individual ML engineer; my role connected these specialist inputs into one implementable AI initiative.
WHY THIS MATTERED
The hardest part was not any one model or system component—it was keeping the business thesis, technical design and operating reality aligned as one program.

svg.text: RECREATED ILLUSTRATION — NOT A CLIENT DOCUMENT
